params.name: series_ids
params.description: List of series IDs separated by commas. A series ID is formatted like provider_code/dataset_code/series_code.

params.name: facets
params.description: Return facets in the response.

params.name: observations
params.description: Return observations (periods and values) for each series in the response.

params.name: metadata
params.description: Return providers and datasets metadata in the response.

params.name: format
params.description: Format of the output. If using csv and the response includes series of different frequencies, many CSV files are produced.

params.name: align_periods
params.description: Ensure that all the periods of each series are defined in every other series, adding NA (not available) values where needed.

params.name: limit
params.description: The number of items to return.

params.name: offset
params.description: The number of items to skip before starting to collect the result set.

items.docs: Responds with a list of series belonging to the same dataset, filterable by dimensions or a full-text query. If the dataset code ends with a format extension (e.g. .csv), some parameters are preset.

info.name: Retrieve series by code or mask

params.name: provider_code
params.description: Code of the provider (e.g. IMF, ECB, Eurostat, BLS, OECD).

params.name: dataset_code
params.description: Code of the dataset.

params.name: series_code

params.name: q
params.description: Full-text search query within the dataset.

items.docs: Responds with the series of a dataset matching a series code or a series code mask (a dimension filter expressed in the code, e.g. using + for alternatives and empty segments as wildcards). Cannot be used with the dimensions parameter.
